judged_text: The diff reshapes the public GET /groups/:name/members response into a {members, meta:{total, limit, offset}} envelope that the new frontend pagination depends on, yet no test in the diff exercises it — the only spec touched is spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb, which never requests GroupsController#members. A regression in the meta envelope (a renamed key or missing total) breaks member pagination on both the admin and public group pages and would pass CI; any pre-existing spec asserting the old flat array shape would have failed and had to be updated in this diff, and none appears, so the new response contract has zero verification.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` to return an envelope `{ members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }` instead of a flat serialized array (see `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`), and the frontend is updated to depend on that shape via `Group#findMembers` reading `result.meta.*` and `result.members` (see `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`). However, the only spec modified in this diff is `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, and it never hits `GroupsController#members` or asserts the new `meta` contract. So the new response shape/pagination contract has no verification in the changed tests, making regressions (e.g., missing/renamed `meta.total`) easy to miss.
